name: You Should Love Her, Not Me
source:
Noah, our MC, is in a dilemma. For quite some time, he's suffered in the silence of love, being unable to confess his feelings for his childhood best friend Zane. He fears that his relationship with his friend would change if he were to admit he was interested in him. You're both boys after all. Not to mention he seems all too close to his other friend, Lana.
